(1) the combination of gradient-based and color-based descriptors outperforms existing approaches for large-scale image database retrieval, (2) the use of a clustering algorithm to reduce the number of images for which the full color image has to be analyzed, and (3) the use of an interactive search interface that allows the user to browse the results of the initial retrieval step, to refine the search, and to add additional sketches to the query.

1) a combination of gradient and color information can be used to achieve good retrieval results, 2) the proposed descriptors scale very well to large databases and 3) a simple, interactive sketch-based search interface is sufficient to achieve a good user experience.

(a) the use of a single descriptor is not sufficient to achieve high performance for large scale retrieval, (b) the proposed combination of two different descriptors is a promising approach, and (c) the proposed descriptors are robust and fast enough to be applied in interactive search.
